redFirst.basis: tests.expectRedFirst is false on this tdd task: it names no case to prove a red by, so no red-first proof is owed

outcome.technical: tools/reach-diff.py and CONTRIBUTING.md only. R19: the hook now reads REACH_DIFF_BLOCK once at install, next to parent, and writes that value in both the start marker and dump(). rd49 runs a hooked process that rewrites the label before it exits and checks the trace is filed under the label it started with. R32, fixing the class and not just this site: the docstring now has an EXIT CODES list of named refusals and is the only copy of the contract. REFUSALS is parsed from __doc__. Every exit-2 site goes through _refuse(result, out, name, why), which prints 'reach-diff: no comparison made (NAME) - ...', records result['refusal'], and raises ValueError for a name the docstring does not list. The usage, prepare, same, judge and recheck sites all converted. Each case asserts its refusal through _refused(seen, text, name). rd62 fails when a documented name has no asserting case or a case asserts an undocumented one. rd63 pins the ValueError. The recheck now compares each block's written, silent and untraced process multisets for equality, so a difference in either direction refuses (recheck-processes), including extra writers (rd58). It compares case ids, the word after PASS/FAIL, when both runs printed them (rd59, rd46), else the contract count, and says which (rd60). recheck-export and recheck-unreadable are covered by direct _judge cases over hand-written traces (rd56, rd57), and rd61 is the allow direction. New refusal cases: hook-probe (rd52, through a new compare(environ=) parameter carrying a broken PYTHONHOME), export (rd53, missing loose blob), unparsable (rd54), unreadable (rd55). CONTRIBUTING.md now keeps only why the tool exists, the author's obligation, the pointer to `python3 tools/reach-diff.py --help`, and the fact that nothing runs it. R33: same_side short-circuits only on same commit, same tree or byte-identical exports. Sides whose differing files are all non-deciding are measured: a loss exits 1 (rd50, data.json flips a branch). Nothing lost exits 2 'no-conversion' (rd42, journal row), or 0 under --allow-same (rd51). R34: in the hook's ident(), an absolute path outside the export root is now kept verbatim. Paths under the block's temp or home directory become <temp> or <home>. The block's first traced process reads those two directories and hands them down in REACH_DIFF_TEMP and REACH_DIFF_HOME, which traced_env pops. rd47 tells apart two children that differ only in an outside path; rd48 matches the same outside path at both sides; rd29's key now reads '<tree>/data <temp>'. Selftest went from 44 to 61 cases, all passing. Dependants: CONTRIBUTING.md was changed as above. hook_line in tests/test__refs.py is that file's own parameter name, so it is unaffected. parse_args, total and compare in other files are namesakes, also unaffected. compare() only gained an optional keyword. Note: I read the implementation before drafting the tests, because I needed the existing contract to write them; the drafted cases still ran red first.
outcome.descriptive: reach-diff's exit and refusal contract now lives once in --help with a selftest per named refusal. It files a process under the block it started in, measures changes confined to data files, and keeps outside paths in child keys.
